title: Building a template: acknowledgement switch, renamed answers, what is kept
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A checkbox field with the follow-up section on, carrying OK, Monitor, Not OK and N/A response blocks with content (seed via Settings - Service).
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a Monitor or Not OK block additionally carries a 'Require acknowledgement' toggle, on by default, while OK and N/A blocks carry no such toggle.
2. Rename a response label and confirm its follow-up is not orphaned (it binds to the response slot, not the label).
3. Uncheck a follow-up's checkbox and confirm the text and file are retained with the fields disabled; turn the section toggle off and confirm every follow-up is retained; turn 'Include Monitor option' off and confirm the Monitor block is removed but its content retained.
4. Turn the section toggle off while a follow-up is checked and confirm the author is asked to confirm.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A Monitor or Not OK block additionally carries a "Require acknowledgement" toggle, on by default; OK and N/A blocks carry no such toggle.
  • A follow-up binds to the response slot, not to its label, so renaming a label does not orphan it.
  • Unchecking the checkbox retains the text and the file (fields disabled); turning the section toggle off retains every follow-up on the field; turning "Include Monitor option" off removes the Monitor block but retains its content.
  • Turning the section toggle off while any follow-up is checked asks the author to confirm.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-R6: “A Monitor or Not OK block will additionally carry a "Require acknowledgement" toggle, on by default. OK and N/A blocks will not carry that toggle at all, because an acknowledgement on a passing response would be created in bulk by the one-press Mark OK of S18 without the technician ever seeing it”
  • S19-R7: “A follow-up binds to the response slot, not to its label, so renaming a label under S12-R11 does not orphan it”
  • S19-R8: “Unchecking the checkbox will retain the text and the file and render the fields disabled. Turning the section toggle off will retain every follow-up on the field. Turning "Include Monitor option" off will remove the Monitor block and retain what was in it”
  • S19-R9: “Turning the section toggle off while any follow-up is checked will ask the author to confirm, because the technician stops seeing text the author wrote”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
